title: a newcomer filters Explore with a filter icon, kind pills and a bottom sheet

criteria.text: Kind pills (All, Events, ... Asks) fixed above the bottom nav, All default
criteria.note: Built in T114 (`KindFilterPills`, W36 log), deleted in #174; Items and `kind=` are gone [V grep: no pills component in `src/components`]. SPEC-CONFLICT with the 2026-09-12 ruling and F092.1 Filed: none (conflict).

criteria.text: No separate market/category/day buttons; filter icon at the right of the sticky search bar
criteria.note: `ExploreSearchBar.tsx` has location pill, search, sliders icon, `sticky top-0` [V]. Invariant half is open guard #624 (F092.1) Checked: unmarked: `ExploreSearchBar.test.tsx`.

criteria.text: Tapping the icon opens a sheet: distance 1/5/10/25, schedule any/week/weekend/recurring, category multi-select, sort; Show results; Clear all when set
criteria.note: Built: sheet with schedule (any/this week/this weekend), tags multi-select, Show results, Clear all when filters are set, half-height, focus trap [V `ExploreFilterSheet.tsx`]. Missing: distance, sort ("no honest point to measure from"), Recurring (PR #174 deviation 4). SPEC-CONFLICT Checked: unmarked: `ExploreFilterSheet.test.tsx` (asserts the built half and the absence of distance, sort, recurring). Filed: none (conflict).

criteria.text: Tapping the Events pill filters instantly to gatherings; pill selected state
criteria.note: No pills, no `item_kind` filter on Browse (results are Pages, not Items). SPEC-CONFLICT Filed: none (conflict).

criteria.text: Active secondary filters show as removable chips below the search bar; no chip for kind
criteria.note: `ActiveFilterChips` deleted in #174; applying the sheet sets filter state only. SPEC-CONFLICT with F092.1 Filed: none (conflict).

criteria.text: Chip row disappears when no chips remain
criteria.note: Nothing to disappear: no chip row exists. SPEC-CONFLICT (follows 5) Filed: none (conflict).

criteria.text: URL carries all active filters (kind + secondary); the URL restores them
criteria.note: Built: `browseQueryString` writes `metro`, `area`, `q`, `category` (tags), `schedule`; `BrowseSurface` seeds filters from `useSearchParams` [V]. Missing: kind, distance, sort are not in the URL; `?sort=`, `?distance=` are ignored on purpose. SPEC-CONFLICT for the missing half Checked: unmarked: `query.test.ts` (round trip), `filters.test.ts`; nothing asserts the page loads them.

criteria.text: Back from an Item page restores filters and scroll
criteria.note: Filters: URL state is rewritten with `router.replace`, so back should restore them [A; no test]. Scroll: no restoration code in `BrowseSurface`; "Item page" is now a Page. Open #54 (F059 T157 "Browse keeps its URL and scroll") covers it

criteria.text: A dot on the filter icon when secondary filters are active
criteria.note: `filter-active-dot` driven by `hasBrowseFilters` (schedule or tags) and an "— filters applied" aria-label [V]. Distance and sort no longer exist to drive it Checked: unmarked: `ExploreSearchBar.test.tsx`.
